system.description:
You used to wear the cape and cowl, but hung them up long ago. Now, something has changed, making you feel compelled to once again take up the fight for what is right. You never thought you would be here again.

Qualities

Assign a d10 and a d10 to two of these qualities:

• Select from Information qualities category

• Select from Social qualities category

Principle

Choose an Identity principle.

Power Source

Roll d12, d6, d6 for power source selection.
